original.target_description: Experiment 1: source memory for faces associated with cheating versus trustworthiness; additional dCheat=dTrust restriction on Base Model 2, likelihood-ratio model comparison. Identified by the supplied replication report citing delta G squared (1)=9.07.

n.sample_role: Experiment 1 participants contributing source-classification responses to the multinomial model; sample comprises 57 female and 28 male participants.
n.exclusions: No participant exclusions reported for Experiment 1.
n.quote: Given a sample size of N=85

es.location: p. 218, Table 2, Additional restriction on Base Model 2, dCheat=dTrust, Experiment 1

p.location: p. 218, Table 2, Additional restriction on Base Model 2, dCheat=dTrust, Experiment 1

replication.target_description: Ghasemi and Szabelska secondary-data replication of the cheating-versus-trustworthy source-memory claim, using Kroneisen (2018) data. Focal formal evaluation of the delta between model G² values with a chi-squared goodness-of-fit test, df=1.

n.sample_role: Participants in the dataset used for the replication; report states the primary unit of analysis is the individual. It separately reports 6804 responses across both task stages.
n.exclusions: Not documented in the replication report; no explicit post-exclusion count distinguished from the dataset participant count.
n.quote: Kroneisen’s study had 63 participants (50 females and 13 males).

es.location: Replication report p. 2, Replication result, immediately following focal chi-squared test

p.location: Replication report p. 2, Replication result, formal evaluation of the delta between the two G² values

reported_success.quote: The criteria for replication were not met

notes: The input provides no study identifiers, neutral description or test locators. The title-verified replication report identifies the original target uniquely by its ΔG²(1)=9.07 result, matching Experiment 1 in Table 2 of the title-verified original. Original phi is not printed for this test; no conversion performed. The original table PDF text renders the less-than sign as b (pb.01), interpreted as p<.01. The replication reports intermediate model statistics as well as a separate focal chi-squared comparison; the extracted p and Phi are from that focal comparison. Formal delta evaluation and Phi were added after preregistration according to the report. Replication N is the explicitly stated dataset participant count; exclusions and a separate final analytic count are not documented.
